entities.name: Caelus Nin
entities.description: Sumifan god of time and patron of the ancestors, depicted with a double-faced basalt head holding an hourglass.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City in Almaaz where Caelus Nin is a god.

entities.name: Ninnites
entities.description: Order following the faith of Caelus Nin, formed in Almaaz around 1050 AR.

events.summary: A basalt head of Caelus Nin forms the double-faced gnomon of a marble sundial at a village gate in Almaaz.
events.quote: a tall, thin basalt head of Caelus Nin formed the double-faced gnomon of a white marble sundial

events.summary: The order of the Ninnites is formed in Almaaz.
events.quote: An order following the faith of Caelus Nin called
